prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity desktop code editor layout proposal for Jotta Edit. Create a crisp landscape UI design image, approximately 1536x1024. Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the dark charcoal Jotta Edit editor in the reference, with background #1f2023, surfaces #242529, borders #35363b, muted grey line icons, yellow accent #ffc107. Do not reproduce the reference's web workspace/import/save/download toolbar; this is the DESKTOP app. Flat screenshot-like design, no perspective or device frame. At top, outside app, clean light neutral margin with the option title and one short subtitle. App has compact title bar with JOTTA EDIT left, jotta-edit workspace centered, standard minimize/maximize/close right; next a menu row File Edit Selection View Go Tools Help. A 230px Explorer sidebar with file and folder icons, project jotta-edit, src folder, main.js, style.css, index.html, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, package.json. Main editor shows a SINGLE tab row with CHANGELOG.md active yellow top border, then main.js, style.css, index.html, README.md, package.json. Tabs take all available space except where this variant explicitly says otherwise. Breadcrumb below: jotta-edit > CHANGELOG.md. Editor shows a few legible Markdown changelog lines with line numbers, title "# Changelog", heading "## 1.1.8", short bullet lines. Status bar bottom: Ready at left; Ln 8, Col 1, Spaces: 2, UTF-8, Markdown, theme toggle right. Keep editor content, sidebar and app size identical across concepts. Toolbar actions are Split (split rectangle), Compare (opposing arrows), Markdown Preview (document/eye), Live Preview (browser/globe), Format (code/brush), Quick Open (magnifier), Commands (command key). Small consistent 16px outline icons in approximately 30px hit areas. Absolutely no long line of icons occupying file tab space except any single overflow control explicitly requested. Include a subtle yellow outline around ONLY the relocated toolbar region, as a design-review annotation. Bottom caption outside app succinctly states tradeoff. Professional production UI concept, restrained, familiar, text sharp and readable. OPTION 1. Exact heading "1 — Menu bar actions". Subtitle "Full-width tabs. Every action stays visible." Place ALL SEVEN action icons horizontally at the FAR RIGHT OF THE EXISTING MENU ROW, following generous empty space after Help. Nothing except file tabs on the tab row. Do not add any new toolbar row. No vertical toolbar. Caption "Recommended: reuses the menu row without taking editor space."
